Browse our Frequently Asked Questions ABOUT SKU FOR FOUNDERS FOR MENTORS Partners & Media ABOUT SKU What is SKU? SKU is the nation’s leading accelerator built exclusively for early-stage consumer product brands. For 15 years, we’ve helped consumer packaged goods founders go from scrappy operators to confident CEOs. Every fall and spring, 7-8 companies experience first-in-class, operator-led curriculum, pitch practice, and hands-on mentorship from CPG industry experts. By the end of 12 weeks, these brands are set up for scale and fundraising. What does “SKU” stand for? In CPG, a SKU (pronounced “skew”) is a Stock Keeping Unit, the barcode on every product on the shelf. Every great brand starts with one. We’re here to help you build the next one shoppers can’t live without. Who is SKU for? Brands that are in-market, have real traction, and are hungry for what’s next. If you’re building a consumer packaged goods brand, from food and beverage to beauty and pet, and you’re ready
If you’re building a consumer packaged goods brand, from food and beverage to beauty and pet, and you’re ready to scale in both retail and DTC, we want to hear from you.
We want to see that your brand has achieved some distribution, either DTC or retail, with real traction (sales).
Additionally, Mentors can be more helpful when Founders have already done the hard work of testing hypotheses.
Twelve weeks designed to accelerate your growth: Kickoff in Austin: In-person connection with your cohort, Mentors, and the SKU Crew.
SKU Mentors and industry partners lead classes on the topics that make or break CPG brands: channel strategy, retail pitching, distribution, supply chain, and fundraising, to name a few.
Mentors bring context and real-life experience from the field, so you can see around corners.
We’ll use that information and Mentor preferences to match you with a team of 6-10 Mentors who are experts in your category and challenges.
Mentors have experience at industry leaders like Coca Cola, P&G, MARS, as well as high-growth startups like UNREAL Snacks and Seventh Generation.

You will leave the program fundraise-ready and financially-prepared: A stage-ready pitch deck and story A clean Data Room A fundraise strategy and progress tracker 3-5 year Financial Projections Lifelong Mentors and friends How much time does SKU require?
It will be intense, but that’s why we call it an accelerator.

In return, you get: A mini-MBA in CPG, taught by industry experts A dedicated Mentor team, plus access to our network of 500+ Mentors Pitch coaching and a spot on the Showcase stage Lifetime access to the SKU Founder, Mentor, and Alumni community Exclusive benefits from select partners such as free access to Byzzer from NielsenIQ, sign-on offers from Ramp , and more.
The clearer your answers, the more you’ll get out of the program, and the better we can match you with the Mentors who can take you there.

Browse our Frequently Asked Questions ABOUT SKU FOR FOUNDERS FOR MENTORS Partners & Media ABOUT SKU What is SKU? SKU is the nation’s leading accelerator built exclusively for early-stage consumer product brands. For 15 years, we’ve helped consumer packaged goods founders go from scrappy operators to confident CEOs. Every fall and spring, 7-8 companies experience first-in-class, operator-led curriculum, pitch practice, and hands-on mentorship from CPG industry experts. By the end of 12 weeks, these brands are set up for scale and fundraising. What does “SKU” stand for? In CPG, a SKU (pronounced “skew”) is a Stock Keeping Unit, the barcode on every product on the shelf. Every great brand starts with one. We’re here to help you build the next one shoppers can’t live without. Who is SKU for? Brands that are in-market, have real traction, and are hungry for what’s next. If you’re building a consumer packaged goods brand, from food and beverage to beauty and pet, and you’re ready
If you’re building a consumer packaged goods brand, from food and beverage to beauty and pet, and you’re ready to scale in both retail and DTC, we want to hear from you.
We want to see that your brand has achieved some distribution, either DTC or retail, with real traction (sales).
Additionally, Mentors can be more helpful when Founders have already done the hard work of testing hypotheses.
Twelve weeks designed to accelerate your growth: Kickoff in Austin: In-person connection with your cohort, Mentors, and the SKU Crew.
SKU Mentors and industry partners lead classes on the topics that make or break CPG brands: channel strategy, retail pitching, distribution, supply chain, and fundraising, to name a few.
Mentors bring context and real-life experience from the field, so you can see around corners.
We’ll use that information and Mentor preferences to match you with a team of 6-10 Mentors who are experts in your category and challenges.
Mentors have experience at industry leaders like Coca Cola, P&G, MARS, as well as high-growth startups like UNREAL Snacks and Seventh Generation.

You will leave the program fundraise-ready and financially-prepared: A stage-ready pitch deck and story A clean Data Room A fundraise strategy and progress tracker 3-5 year Financial Projections Lifelong Mentors and friends How much time does SKU require?
It will be intense, but that’s why we call it an accelerator.

In return, you get: A mini-MBA in CPG, taught by industry experts A dedicated Mentor team, plus access to our network of 500+ Mentors Pitch coaching and a spot on the Showcase stage Lifetime access to the SKU Founder, Mentor, and Alumni community Exclusive benefits from select partners such as free access to Byzzer from NielsenIQ, sign-on offers from Ramp , and more.
The clearer your answers, the more you’ll get out of the program, and the better we can match you with the Mentors who can take you there.
